title: Operational readiness stress test playbook + KPI heatmap
body:
Purpose:
Short checklist and lightweight KPI heatmap to drive operational readiness and stress-test outcomes for major feature launches (dedicated + hosted). Use as the canonical table for product-ops + SRE go/no-go scoring.

Scope:
- Covers launch phases: bake / canary / open rollout / post-launch stabilization.
- Focused on: latency & tail-latency, token-cost, error-rate, infra capacity, rollback surface, and user-impact signals (support volume, adoption).
- Not a full runbook for customer incidents — links to incident runbooks are below.

How to use this sheet (quick):
1) Update the KPI rows with latest baseline numbers from infra dashboards (last 24h & 7d).
2) Run the stress profile in staging (see linked_artifacts) and paste observed values in STRESS column.
3) Score each KPI with the rubric (green=0, amber=1, red=2). Sum -> go/no-go thresholds.
4) Product-ops + SRE + Eng lead must sign-off if total score <= 2. >2 requires mitigations and re-test.

KPI HEATMAP (columns):
Metric | Baseline (7d median) | Baseline (99p) | Target SLO | Stress test result | Owner | Monitor query | Acceptable delta | Score | Notes
Latency p50 (gen route) | 180ms | 520ms | p50 < 250ms | 210ms | Priya Nair | infra.metrics.latency.gen.p50{route="/v1/generate"} | +30% | 0 | acceptable, small bump under synthetic load
Latency p99 (gen route) | 1.8s | 3.9s | p99 < 2.5s | 4.6s | Priya Nair | infra.metrics.latency.gen.p99 | +150% | 2 | red: KV cache miss pattern seen, follow-up ticket RDW-3021
Token cost per 1k (hosted-standard) | $0.85 | n/a | <= $1.00 | $0.93 | Evan Roberts | billing.token_cost.1k | +10% | 0 | within target but cost regression vs baseline
API error rate (4xx+5xx) | 0.4% | n/a | <1% | 1.6% | Jordan Kim | infra.metrics.errors.total | +300% | 2 | red: spike correlated with burst traffic from test harness
Model fallback rate (auto-fallback to alt-model) | 0.2% | n/a | <0.5% | 0.7% | Jordan Kim | routing.fallback.rate | +250% | 1 | amber: routing config needs stricter circuit-breaker
Throughput (requests/s) | 420 rps | n/a | sustain 350 rps | 380 rps | Evan Roberts | infra.metrics.rps | +9% capacity headroom | 0 | safe margin for canary
Support tickets in 24h (predicted) | 12 | n/a | <30 | 38 | Product Ops | support.predict.volume | +216% | 2 | red: escalate docs + CS standby needed
Model quality eval (BLEU/ROUGE-like surrogate) | 0.86 qual-score | n/a | >=0.85 | 0.84 | Priya Nair | qa.evals.latest | -1.2% | 1 | amber: small regression flagged by unit eval set
Observability coverage (traces per request) | 1.0 spans/req | n/a | >=0.9 | 0.98 | Liam O'Connor | observability.coverage.rate | -2% | 0 | fine
Cold-start latency (first token) | 600ms | n/a | <700ms | 920ms | Liam O'Connor | infra.metrics.cold_start | +53% | 2 | red: warm pool sizing insufficient in test config

SUM SCORE CALCULATION:
- Sum all Score column values.
- Green=0, Amber=1, Red=2.
- Decision thresholds: 0-2 = GO (minor watchlist items ok), 3-5 = HOLD (mitigations required + re-test), 6+ = NO-GO (rollback or postpone).
Current sum: 10 -> NO-GO.

Top 5 Mitigations (action items):
1) KV cache tuning: bump warm-KV pool by 25% and re-run p99 test (owner: Priya) -> ticket RDW-3021 (blocking).
2) Rate-limiter tightening on canary traffic to reduce fallback & errors (owner: Jordan) -> change review required.
3) Add hot-warm warmers to reduce cold starts (owner: Liam) -> infra PR #89.
4) Customer support pre-brief + FAQ update before canary open (owner: Samira) -> draft in linked_artifacts.
5) Abort open rollout until token-cost regression explained (owner: Evan) -> investigate batch size / quantization delta.

Go/No-Go decision rubric (simple):
- Signatures required: Product-ops lead, Eng lead (serving-runtime), SRE manager.
- Attach evidence: stress test logs, dashboards (24h + synthetic), and updated KPI heatmap.
- If NO-GO: capture root causes, target re-test window, and mitigation owners.

Rollout Phases + quick ops checklist:
- Bake (internal infra + 5% traffic): confirm no red KPIs for 48h, cost within +10%
- Canary (10% traffic): run stress curves + support smoke tests; if any red, revert to bake or pause
- Open rollout (ramp): rolling ramp 10->25->50->100 over 48–72h with checkpoints (metrics, support, errors)
- Post-launch (7d): daily ops sync, metric regressions triage, SLA backfills if needed

Quick RACI (single-line rows for sheet):
- KPI tracking = Product-ops (Samira) [Accountable], SRE (Liam) [Responsible], Eng (Priya/Evan) [Consulted]
- Rollout gating = Product-ops + Eng lead [Accountable], SRE [Responsible]
- Customer comms = CS [Responsible], Product-ops [Consulted]

Open questions / TODOs:
- QA: expand eval set to include long-context prompts (action: Priya).
- Billing: is token-cost increase fully explained by model weights / quantization? (Evan investigating).
- Obs: add histogram for KV-cache misses to the SLO dashboard (Liam).

Quick update log (auditable):
2026-02-20 | Samira P. | Ran end-to-end stress harness; preliminary results added.
2026-02-23 | Priya N. | Identified KV miss pattern, raised RDW-3021.
2026-02-28 | Evan R. | Confirmed cost delta correlates with batch-size rollback; PR to revert submitted.
2026-03-05 | Jordan K. | Error spike traced to malformed canary payload; fixed validation in router.

Attached / recommended artifacts (links):
- Synthetic stress harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infratest
- Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/launch-readiness/heatmap
- Incident runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INC-PLAYBOOK-22
- Support FAQ draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1support-faq-draft

Notes to reviewer:
- This sheet is intentionally concise — keep operational decisions scoped to measurable KPIs.
- Add new KPI rows if your feature has unique user-impact signals (e.g., streaming token-drop, embedding drift).
- If you update numbers, append a quick note in update log with a short justification.

End of doc.
